cohort: 500 antenatal patients after 28 weeks of gestation with singleton pregnancies attending an outpatient clinic at a hospital in Chandigarh, India, of whom 200 were randomly selected and divided into four groups based on the presence or absence of bacterial vaginosis and periodontal infection.
finding: A significant correlation was found between periodontal infection and preterm labor and preterm premature rupture of membranes.
